name: Audio Ingest (Normalize & Convert)
purpose: Normalize and convert a single audio (or media) file to a requested format, sample rate, channel count, sample format, and optional loudness normalization, by wrapping ffmpeg/ffprobe. The front door for the audio track: defaults produce whisper-ready 16 kHz mono s16 WAV. Deterministic transcode; no model. Reads one input, writes one fresh audio artifact plus a machine/human record.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (required); -Format <wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a>; -SampleRate <hz|0=keep>; -Channels <1|2|0=keep>; -SampleFormat <s16|s24|s32|flt> (wav only); -Loudness <none|peak|ebu>; -PeakDb <dBFS>; -LoudnessI/-LoudnessTP/-LoudnessLRA <EBU targets>; -Bitrate <e.g. 192k> (lossy); -FfmpegPath/-FfprobePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,format,sample_rate,channels,sample_fmt,loudness,peak_db,loudness_i,loudness_tp,loudness_lra,bitrate,ffmpeg_path,ffprobe_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source audio/media file. The first audio stream is used (audio extracted from video containers).

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Target format/container: wav | mp3 | flac | opus | ogg | m4a.

inputs.name: sample_rate
inputs.description: Output sample rate in Hz. 0 keeps the source rate.

inputs.name: channels
inputs.description: Output channel count: 1 (mono) or 2 (stereo). 0 keeps the source layout.

inputs.name: sample_fmt
inputs.description: PCM sample format for wav only: s16 | s24 | s32 | flt. Ignored (with a warning) for other formats.

inputs.name: loudness
inputs.description: Loudness normalization: none | peak (two-pass to -PeakDb) | ebu (EBU R128 loudnorm).

inputs.name: peak_db
inputs.description: Target peak in dBFS for loudness=peak.

inputs.name: loudness_i
inputs.description: EBU integrated loudness target (LUFS) for loudness=ebu.

inputs.name: loudness_lra
inputs.description: EBU loudness range target (LU) for loudness=ebu.

inputs.name: bitrate
inputs.description: Audio bitrate for lossy formats (mp3/opus/ogg/m4a), e.g. 192k. Per-format default when omitted.

inputs.name: ffmpeg_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffmpeg.exe path override (else resolved from PATH / known locations).

inputs.name: ffprobe_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffprobe.exe path override (else the sibling of the resolved ffmpeg).
